verdict.rationale: OpenTofu is a documented CLI tool (`tofu plan`, `tofu apply`, `tofu test`, `tofu import`), so it runs headlessly by design. The docs describe CI-style patterns: saving a plan with `-out=FILE` to apply later, and running speculative plans before code review. Community users also describe drop-in replacement of terraform in existing workflows. Missing for 10: explicit CI/automation documentation (e.g., non-interactive flags such as -auto-approve/-input=false, machine-readable output, CI pipeline guides), independent hands-on reports of CI usage.
